chunks: It is God who creates you, then makes you die; and some reach the age of dotage when they forget what they had known before. God is indeed all-knowing and all-powerful.

key_terms.أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ: the lowest stage of life / old age/dotage
key_terms.يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ: makes you die / takes your souls

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the loss of knowledge in old age?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine wisdom behind the natural decline of faculties in old age, serving as a humbling reminder of human fragility and the transient nature of worldly knowledge. It underscores that while physical and mental faculties may deteriorate, God’s omnipotence remains absolute, reinforcing the believer’s reliance on divine mercy rather than personal intellect alone.
